additional_info.subject: ID0440876-DC/Si-D/GR-[MP / R2 170001506] Unable to charge CRM:02919000235
additional_info.body:
Hi Olympia, good afternoon.
Since this charger is out of warranty, I will provide you a quick and detailed view of the charging sessions performed since 7 days ago, I send in attachment to provide to customer if required.
As you can see, in the column EVMAC, there are numerous sessions where we don't have a value. This is because the EV didn't establish a connection the charger.
If you check all the other sessions which have a value in EVMAC, you can see Energy Transfer.
Both outlets charged since last 7 days so I don't think there is a problem with charging, the problem looks to be on the EV side.
Let me know your feedback.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
